After no small amount of trial & error, I have managed to replace the subverse name with an image.
You can view the finished result at /v/PCBSD, /v/Fedora, or examine the code below:

/* Sub name as Image */

.pagename a:after, .titlebox .whoaversename a[href$="/v/pcbsd"]:after {

 content: url('http://oi58.tinypic.com/fnqouu.jpg');

}

/* This makes sure the subverse name text is hidden */

.pagename a, .titlebox .whoaversename a[href$="/v/pcbsd"] {

 font-size: 0!important;

}

I've found this works best when the image height is ~ 25 pixels.

Shout out to /u/chmod with this tutorial which was the original basis for my work.

Enjoy!
